arguments.rule_content:
title: Excessive Debug Logging Enabled on SIEM
logsource:
  product: siem
  service: logging_pipeline
condition: |
  log_level: 'debug' AND 
  storage_utilization > 95%
detection:
  debug_enabled: 
    log_level: 'debug'
  high_utilization:
    storage_utilization|float > 95
  timeframe: 5m
  condition: debug_enabled and high_utilization
level: high

title: Service Account Lockout During High Log Volume
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: security
condition: |
  event_id: 4740 AND 
  process_name: 'siem-ingest*' AND 
  log_volume_rate > 10000 events/sec
detection:
  account_lockout:
    event_id: 4740
  high_log_ingest:
    process_name: 'siem-ingest*'
    log_volume_rate|float > 10000
  timeframe: 1m
  condition: account_lockout and high_log_ingest
level: medium
